content.text: Madhya Pradesh Ayush Counselling 2025 is the state counselling conducted for admission to Ayush courses: BAMS/BNYS/BUMS/BSMS/BHMS by the Department of Ayush, Government of Madhya Pradesh . The private and government Ayush colleges participating in the counselling are recognized by the NCISM and NCH. NEET is the mandatory requirement for participating in the MP Ayush counselling. Madhya Pradesh Ayush Counselling is supervised by the Department of Ayush, Government of Madhya Pradesh. Admission is offered to Ayurveda, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homeopathy colleges in Madhya Pradesh, recognized by the National Commission for Indian System of Medicine (NCISM) and, National Commission for Homeopathy (NCH). The candidates have to register with the MP Ayush Counselling official website at https://ayush.mponline.gov.in/ to participate in the counselling.

NEET-UG qualification is the mandatory and primary requirement for admission to Ayush colleges in Madhya Pradesh. The Ayush Counselling reserves 85% of the seats for the domicile students of Madhya Pradesh under the State Quota. The remaining 15% seats are under the All India Quota (AIQ), where students from other states can apply to the government and private colleges in Madhya Pradesh. All India Quota (AIQ) seats counselling is conducted by the Ayush Admissions Central Counseling Committee AACCC .

The institutions participating in the Counselling include 24 BHMS colleges, 4 BUMS colleges, 2 BNYS colleges, and 35 BAMS colleges in Madhya Pradesh . Currently, there are no BSMS colleges in the state.
Here is the date and schedule for important events involved in the MP Ayush Counselling procedure in 2025.
Below mentioned are the eligibility requirements to be met by the candidates to participate in the MP Ayush Counselling 2025.
Academic Requirement

items: Candidates must have 10+2 from a recognized board
Candidates must score at least 50% aggregate in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology subjects in the 12th standard in the case of general category candidates.
Candidates must score at least 40% aggregate in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology subjects in the 12th standard in case of reserved category candidates.
Candidates must have studied English as a subject in the 12th grade.

content.text: Entrance Examination

items: All candidates applying for counselling must be qualified in NEET-UG 2025.

content.text: Age Limit

items: As of December 2025, the age of candidates must not be less than 17 years.

items: The domicile students of Madhya Pradesh can apply under the State Quota, while students from other states have to apply under the All India Quota (AIQ), conducted by AACCC for admission to Ayush colleges in Madhya Pradesh.

Allotment is made after considering the Merit/ NEET scores/ Reservation/ Choices of colleges.
The Allotment list will be published on the official website. Log in with your credentials to check the results.
Download the Allotment Letter from the website for further admission procedure.
Report to the allotted college with the relevant original certificates and documents for verification.
Make payment of the prescribed fees for completing the admission procedure.
Visit the official website of AACCC, www.aaccc.gov.in, and register using your mobile number.
Fill out the application with all the personal and academic details.
Make payment of the counselling fees as prescribed according to the category.
Upload the necessary documents and certificates to the website to complete the application.
The candidates can fill in their choices of colleges and state in the option entry form.
It is mandatory to lock the choices before the last date.
Seats are allotted in multiple rounds: Round 1/ Round 2/ Round 3/ Stray Vacancy Round.
Stray Vacancy Round is conducted for the vacant seats after the previous rounds.
Seats are allotted as per the NEET scores, merit rank, reservation, and preference of colleges.

Download the Allotment List from the official website for further admission procedure.
